title: Split storage ownership: six core tables, Audit schema, migration and health (D19, D20)
summary: `StorageSchema` creates/drops six core tables; the schema-1 upgrade migration, `StorageSchema::upgrade()` and the schema-1 hint go (D20); Audit gets `Audit\Internal\AuditSchema`, the create-only migration `2026_10_20_000000_create_azguard_audit_log` published under `azguard-audit-migrations`, the stub and `azguard:audit:migration {storage}`, `AuditServiceProvider` (publish tag + console commands) and the `audit.table` presence/shape check; core health/doctor know six tables. 0.7.0 populated fixtures are removed and the NoScope parity world seeds through the current API (D19). DDL fixtures per driver for core-only and core+Audit.
why: Phase deliverable 'six-table StorageSchema … Audit migration with fixed basename … per-storage generator'; I13 (core-only needs no audit table), I15, I16 as amended (knowledge/p3-execution#persistence). Hard risks: the audit table built by AuditSchema must be byte-identical in DDL to today's (columns, types, nullability, indexes, unique event_id, tenant pair constraint/SQLite triggers) on all four drivers; test infrastructure must create the audit table only for tests that attach Audit, otherwise I13 is faked.

include: `Storage\Schema\StorageSchema`: create/drop six tables (audit block removed), `upgrade()` removed; `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_09_000000_upgrade_azguard_storage_to_schema_2.php` deleted; `Storage\Storage` mismatch message without the schema-1 hint; `Sources\Database\StorageHealth` and doctor checks `StorageMigrated`/`StorageSchema`/`ModelColumns` know six tables; `StorageMigrationCommand` stub generates six tables

`modules/audit/src/Internal/AuditSchema.php` (create/drop for a `StorageDescriptor`, via `Storage\Schema\IdentityColumns`), `modules/audit/database/migrations/2026_10_20_000000_create_azguard_audit_log.php` (up create on `default`, down drop), `modules/audit/stubs/audit-migration.stub`, `modules/audit/src/Internal/Console/AuditMigrationCommand.php` (`azguard:audit:migration {storage}`, CommandSupport::attempt exit codes), `modules/audit/src/AuditServiceProvider.php` (#[Api], publishes the migrations directory under `azguard-audit-migrations` with plain `publishes()`, registers its commands only in console, no I/O); `packages/core/composer.json` extra.laravel.providers adds `AzGuard\\Audit\\AuditServiceProvider` (then composer update, #commands); oracle already lists AuditSchema/AuditMigrationCommand/AuditServiceProvider

`Audit\Internal\Checks\AuditTableExists` (`audit.table`): presence on the writer storage of each audited panel with the publish/command remedy, plus shape comparison against AuditSchema (missing/extra columns, index names) as error findings

Tests: core `TestCase`/fixtures create audit_log through AuditSchema only where a test attaches AuditPlugin; DDL fixtures `tests/Fixtures/Storage/ddl/<driver>.json` regenerate for six tables plus a new audit DDL fixture per driver; fresh-install scenario tests of knowledge/p3-execution#persistence (package-loaded, published, Audit default, Audit named storage, rollback) in `tests/Feature/Storage` and `tests/Engines/StorageDdlTest.php` lanes; `tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Persistence/**` and `tests/Regression/Baseline070/PopulatedDatabaseTest.php` deleted; `tests/Fixtures/Parity/NoScopeWorld.php` rewritten to seed scoped rows through the current API then remove the plugin; schema-1 cases of `SubjectRevisionsTest` deleted; `Formats/resources.json` and doctor fixtures regenerated deliberately
Allowlists: i2 entries `StorageSchema.php`/`StorageHealth.php` (`audit_log`) removed; InactiveCost `audit_log` entry removed (core-only doctor green without it)

Migration lines: one core migration (delete a published upgrade copy), fresh audited install steps (`vendor:publish --tag=azguard-audit-migrations`, `azguard:audit:migration <storage>`), `StorageSchema::upgrade()` removed
exclude: Any change of the audit_log row format or payload
